brief: Senior Full Stack Engineer (React, TypeScript, Node.js, PostgreSQL, AWS) at a fintech payments startup
job_description:
About PayBridge Labs
PayBridge Labs is a venture-backed fintech payments startup building modern payment orchestration, merchant onboarding, and reconciliation tools for software platforms and digital marketplaces. Our customers use PayBridge to route card and ACH payments, manage payouts, reduce payment failures, and understand transaction risk in real time. We are a small, product-focused engineering team that values ownership, pragmatic architecture, and close collaboration with product, design, compliance, and customer success.

Role summary
We are hiring a Senior Full Stack Engineer to help build the next generation of our payments platform. You will work across our React and TypeScript frontend, Node.js services, PostgreSQL data layer, and AWS infrastructure. This role is ideal for someone who has shipped production SaaS products, enjoys solving complex business and data problems, and wants to have a meaningful impact on a growing fintech product.

Responsibilities
- Design, build, and maintain customer-facing web applications using React, TypeScript, and modern frontend patterns.
- Develop reliable backend services and APIs in Node.js for payment flows, merchant configuration, reporting, reconciliation, and internal operations.
- Model data and write efficient queries in PostgreSQL for transaction-heavy workflows.
- Collaborate with product managers and designers to turn ambiguous requirements into secure, scalable features.
- Improve system observability, test coverage, CI/CD workflows, and operational reliability.
- Work with AWS services to deploy, monitor, and scale applications in production.
- Participate in architecture discussions, code reviews, incident response, and technical planning.
- Mentor other engineers and help raise the quality of our engineering practices.
- Partner with compliance and security stakeholders to build features that support auditability, data protection, and payment industry expectations.

Required qualifications
- 6+ years of professional software engineering experience, including significant full stack development.
- Strong hands-on experience with React and TypeScript in production applications.
- Professional experience building backend services with Node.js, preferably using frameworks such as Express, NestJS, Fastify, or similar.
- Solid PostgreSQL experience, including schema design, indexing, migrations, and query optimization.
- Experience deploying or operating applications on AWS, such as ECS, Lambda, RDS, S3, CloudWatch, SQS, or similar services.
- Strong understanding of REST APIs, authentication, authorization, and secure coding practices.
- Experience with automated testing, code reviews, CI/CD, and production debugging.
- Ability to communicate clearly, make pragmatic tradeoffs, and work effectively in a fast-moving startup environment.

Nice-to-haves
- Experience in payments, banking, lending, accounting, or another regulated financial domain.
- Familiarity with payment processors, ACH, card networks, payouts, ledger systems, or reconciliation workflows.
- Experience with event-driven architecture, queues, and asynchronous processing.
- Knowledge of infrastructure as code tools such as Terraform or AWS CDK.
- Experience with SOC 2, PCI DSS, or other compliance-oriented engineering practices.
- Familiarity with analytics, experimentation, or data visualization for financial operations teams.

Benefits
- Competitive salary and meaningful equity package.
- Medical, dental, and vision coverage for employees and dependents.
- Flexible PTO and paid company holidays.
- Remote-friendly work with quarterly team gatherings.
- Home office stipend and monthly wellness allowance.
- 401(k) plan with company match.
- Learning budget for conferences, books, and professional development.
- Opportunity to help shape the engineering culture and technical direction of an early-stage fintech company.

brief: Data Engineer (Spark, Airflow, Snowflake, dbt, Python) at a healthcare analytics company
job_description:
About ClearPath Health Analytics
ClearPath Health Analytics is a healthcare data and insights company helping payers, provider groups, and value-based care organizations make better decisions using trusted data products. Our platform brings together claims, eligibility, clinical, pharmacy, and operational datasets to support population health, quality improvement, cost management, and care coordination. We are a remote-friendly team with offices in Denver and Boston, and we care deeply about data quality, patient privacy, and building systems that scale responsibly.

Role Summary
We are hiring a Data Engineer to join our Data Platform team. In this role, you will build and maintain batch and near-real-time data pipelines that power analytics, reporting, and machine learning use cases across healthcare domains. You will work with Spark, Airflow, Snowflake, dbt, and Python to ingest, transform, validate, and model complex healthcare datasets. The ideal candidate has hands-on experience with modern cloud data platforms, understands data engineering best practices, and can collaborate closely with analytics engineers, data scientists, product managers, and compliance stakeholders.

Responsibilities
- Design, build, and maintain scalable data pipelines using Python, Apache Spark, and orchestration tools such as Airflow.
- Develop and optimize Snowflake data models, tables, views, and warehouse usage patterns for analytics workloads.
- Build and maintain dbt models, tests, documentation, and lineage for core data marts and reusable analytics layers.
- Ingest and transform healthcare data sources including claims, eligibility files, provider rosters, clinical feeds, and third-party reference datasets.
- Partner with analytics engineers and business stakeholders to translate reporting requirements into reliable data products.
- Implement data quality checks, monitoring, alerting, and incident response processes for production pipelines.
- Improve pipeline performance, cost efficiency, and reliability through code reviews, testing, and platform best practices.
- Work with security and compliance teams to ensure data handling aligns with HIPAA, SOC 2, and internal governance standards.
- Participate in agile planning, technical design discussions, and documentation of data architecture decisions.

Required Qualifications
- 4+ years of professional data engineering experience building production data pipelines.
- Strong Python programming skills for data processing, automation, and integration work.
- Hands-on experience with Apache Spark or PySpark in production or large-scale data processing environments.
- Experience orchestrating workflows with Apache Airflow or a comparable scheduler.
- Strong SQL skills and experience with a cloud data warehouse such as Snowflake, BigQuery, or Redshift.
- Experience designing dimensional models, data marts, or analytics-ready datasets.
- Familiarity with CI/CD, version control with Git, and software engineering practices for data projects.
- Ability to troubleshoot complex data issues and communicate clearly with technical and non-technical partners.

Nice-to-Haves
- Direct experience with Snowflake and dbt in a production analytics environment.
- Healthcare data experience, especially medical claims, eligibility, HL7, FHIR, or quality measures.
- Experience with AWS services such as S3, Glue, Lambda, EMR, or IAM.
- Knowledge of data governance, privacy, and security practices in regulated environments.
- Experience with streaming tools such as Kafka or Kinesis.
- Familiarity with Terraform, Docker, Kubernetes, or other infrastructure automation tools.
- Exposure to observability tools such as Datadog, Monte Carlo, Great Expectations, or OpenLineage.

Benefits
- Competitive salary and annual performance bonus.
- Medical, dental, and vision coverage with company-paid options.
- 401(k) plan with employer match.
- Flexible PTO, paid holidays, and paid parental leave.
- Remote-first work environment with optional office hubs.
- Annual learning budget for conferences, certifications, and courses.
- Home office stipend and monthly wellness reimbursement.
- Opportunity to work on data products that improve healthcare outcomes at scale.

brief: Machine Learning Engineer (LLMs, PyTorch, RAG, MLOps on GCP) at a B2B SaaS company
job_description:
Company intro
Northstar Relay is a B2B SaaS company helping customer success, sales engineering, and support teams turn product knowledge into accurate answers for enterprise buyers and customers. Our platform connects to docs, tickets, CRM notes, call transcripts, and internal wikis to power AI search, workflow automation, and account intelligence. We serve mid-market and enterprise software companies and are growing our applied AI team after a recent Series B.

Role summary
We are hiring a Machine Learning Engineer to build production LLM features with a focus on retrieval-augmented generation, model evaluation, and reliable deployment on Google Cloud Platform. You will work with product managers, backend engineers, data engineers, and customer-facing teams to ship AI capabilities that are useful, measurable, and safe for business users. This is a hands-on engineering role for someone who enjoys PyTorch, experimentation, and the realities of operating ML systems in production.

Responsibilities
- Design, build, and maintain RAG pipelines for enterprise knowledge sources, including document ingestion, chunking, embeddings, retrieval, reranking, prompting, and response generation.
- Develop and fine-tune LLM-based features using PyTorch and modern transformer architectures where appropriate.
- Create offline and online evaluation frameworks for answer quality, hallucination risk, latency, cost, and customer-specific success metrics.
- Build model serving, monitoring, and retraining workflows on GCP using services such as Vertex AI, Cloud Run, GKE, BigQuery, Pub/Sub, and Cloud Storage.
- Collaborate with backend engineers to expose ML services through secure APIs and integrate with a multi-tenant SaaS architecture.
- Improve observability for ML systems, including drift detection, prompt/version tracking, data quality checks, and incident response playbooks.
- Partner with security and compliance teams to handle sensitive customer data responsibly.
- Mentor other engineers on LLM development practices, code quality, and reproducible experimentation.

Required qualifications
- 5+ years of professional software or machine learning engineering experience, including at least 2 years building production ML systems.
- Strong Python programming skills and hands-on experience with PyTorch.
- Practical experience with LLMs, embeddings, vector search, RAG, prompt engineering, and model evaluation.
- Experience deploying ML services in production on GCP or a comparable cloud platform.
- Familiarity with MLOps practices such as CI/CD, model registry, experiment tracking, monitoring, containerization, and automated testing.
- Solid understanding of distributed systems, APIs, data pipelines, and SQL.
- Ability to communicate tradeoffs clearly to technical and non-technical stakeholders.

Nice-to-haves

- Experience with vector databases such as Pinecone, Weaviate, Milvus, Chroma, or pgvector.
- Experience with LangChain, LlamaIndex, Hugging Face Transformers, vLLM, or similar tooling.
- Familiarity with SOC 2, GDPR, data residency, or enterprise security requirements.

Benefits

- Medical, dental, and vision coverage for employees and dependents.
- Flexible PTO, paid company holidays, and parental leave.
- Remote-friendly work in the United States and Canada, with optional offices in Austin and Toronto.

brief: Site Reliability Engineer (Kubernetes, Terraform, AWS, Prometheus, incident response) at an e-commerce marketplace
job_description:
About Cartlane
Cartlane is a fast-growing e-commerce marketplace connecting millions of buyers with independent sellers across home goods, apparel, electronics, and specialty retail. Our platform processes high-volume traffic spikes during promotions, product launches, and seasonal events, and reliability is central to our customer and seller experience. We are building a stronger infrastructure team to improve availability, deployment safety, observability, and incident response across our cloud-native environment.

Role Summary
We are looking for a Site Reliability Engineer to join our Infrastructure and Platform Engineering group. In this role, you will help operate and improve our Kubernetes-based production systems running on AWS, build infrastructure with Terraform, strengthen monitoring and alerting with Prometheus, and participate in incident response for customer-facing services. You will work closely with backend engineers, data teams, security, and product groups to make our marketplace more resilient, scalable, and easier to operate.

Responsibilities
- Operate, maintain, and improve Kubernetes clusters supporting high-traffic marketplace services.
- Build, review, and maintain infrastructure as code using Terraform across AWS environments.
- Improve service reliability through SLOs, error budgets, alert tuning, runbooks, and post-incident reviews.
- Participate in an on-call rotation and lead or support production incident response.
- Develop automation for deployments, scaling, failover, and routine operational tasks.
- Partner with engineering teams to improve service observability using Prometheus, Grafana, logs, and tracing tools.
- Identify performance bottlenecks and reliability risks in distributed systems.
- Support CI/CD pipelines and safe release practices, including canary deployments and rollback strategies.
- Help manage AWS services such as EKS, EC2, ALB/NLB, RDS, S3, IAM, Route 53, CloudWatch, and VPC networking.
- Contribute to security, compliance, cost optimization, and disaster recovery initiatives.

Required Qualifications
- 5+ years of experience in infrastructure, DevOps, SRE, platform engineering, or production operations.
- Hands-on experience running production workloads in AWS.
- Practical experience with Kubernetes in a production or large staging environment.
- Experience writing and maintaining Terraform or similar infrastructure as code.
- Familiarity with Prometheus-based monitoring and alerting.
- Experience responding to production incidents, writing postmortems, and improving operational processes.
- Strong Linux, networking, and troubleshooting fundamentals.
- Experience with CI/CD systems such as GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Jenkins, CircleCI, or similar.
- Ability to write scripts or small services in Python, Go, Bash, or similar languages.
- Clear communication skills and comfort working across engineering teams.

Nice-to-Haves
- Experience supporting e-commerce, payments, marketplace, or other high-traffic customer-facing platforms.
- Experience with service mesh, OpenTelemetry, distributed tracing, or log aggregation platforms.
- Familiarity with Argo CD, Helm, Kustomize, or GitOps workflows.
- Experience with Kafka, Redis, PostgreSQL, or other stateful services in cloud environments.
- AWS certifications or Kubernetes certifications such as CKA or CKAD.
- Experience with chaos testing, load testing, or capacity planning for peak events.

Benefits
- Competitive salary, annual bonus eligibility, and equity grants.
- Medical, dental, and vision coverage for employees and dependents.
- Flexible PTO, paid holidays, and parental leave.
- Remote-friendly work with quarterly team gatherings.
- Home office stipend and monthly internet reimbursement.
- Learning budget for conferences, certifications, and technical training.
- 401(k) with company match.
- A collaborative engineering culture focused on reliability, ownership, and continuous improvement.

brief: Senior iOS Engineer (Swift, SwiftUI, Combine, Core Data, CI for mobile) at a consumer fitness app

brief: Technical Product Manager (API platform, B2B SaaS, roadmap, SQL, analytics, developer experience)
job_description:
Company Intro
RelayForge is a fast-growing B2B SaaS company helping logistics, fintech, and healthcare teams automate partner data exchange through secure APIs, workflow orchestration, and real-time analytics. Our platform processes more than 900 million API calls per month and serves product, engineering, and operations teams at mid-market and enterprise customers. We are remote-friendly, pragmatic, and focused on building developer tools that are powerful without being painful to adopt.

Role Summary
We are hiring a Technical Product Manager to lead core initiatives for our API platform. This person will own roadmap discovery and delivery for developer experience, API lifecycle tooling, usage analytics, and customer-facing platform capabilities. You will work closely with engineering, design, customer success, sales engineering, and external developers to turn ambiguous platform needs into well-scoped product investments. This role is ideal for someone who can discuss API design tradeoffs with engineers, analyze product usage in SQL, and translate customer problems into a clear roadmap.

Responsibilities
- Own the roadmap for API platform capabilities including onboarding, authentication flows, API documentation, usage dashboards, and self-service configuration.
- Partner with engineering leads to define requirements, prioritize technical debt, and make tradeoffs across scalability, usability, security, and delivery timelines.
- Conduct customer discovery with technical buyers, developers, solution architects, and internal go-to-market teams.
- Use SQL, product analytics, and customer feedback to identify adoption bottlenecks, measure feature success, and recommend improvements.
- Write clear PRDs, API workflow diagrams, release notes, and launch plans for technical and non-technical audiences.
- Improve developer experience by simplifying integration paths, reducing time to first successful API call, and improving documentation quality.
- Collaborate with product marketing and sales engineering to package platform capabilities for B2B SaaS customers.
- Define success metrics, monitor performance after launch, and iterate based on data and customer input.

Required Qualifications
- 5+ years of product management experience, including at least 2 years working on API platforms, developer tools, integrations, or technical B2B SaaS products.
- Strong understanding of REST APIs, authentication patterns, webhooks, SDKs, API documentation, and integration workflows.
- Hands-on ability to query data using SQL and interpret product usage analytics.
- Experience building and communicating product roadmaps, prioritization frameworks, requirements, and launch plans.
- Proven ability to work closely with engineering teams on complex technical products.
- Strong written communication skills, especially for technical documentation, customer-facing release notes, and executive updates.
- Comfort working with enterprise customers, technical stakeholders, and cross-functional teams.

Nice-to-Haves
- Experience with GraphQL, OAuth 2.0, OpenAPI, Postman, Datadog, Snowflake, Looker, Amplitude, or Segment.
- Background in logistics, fintech, healthcare data exchange, or other integration-heavy industries.
- Experience improving developer portals, API reference documentation, SDK adoption, or sandbox environments.
- Familiarity with pricing, packaging, or monetization for API usage-based products.
- Technical degree or previous experience as an engineer, solutions architect, data analyst, or technical consultant.

Benefits
- Competitive salary and equity package.
- Remote-first work environment in the United States with optional office hubs in Austin and Denver.
- Medical, dental, and vision insurance with generous employer contribution.
- 401(k) plan, paid parental leave, flexible PTO, and company-wide recharge days.
- Annual learning stipend, home office budget, and conference support.
- Opportunity to shape a high-scale API platform used by thousands of developers and enterprise teams.
